one_liner: Help desk and call center software with ticketing, live chat, built-in call center, and API access.
access_notes: A self-serve free trial is available, and API access is included in subscriptions.
verdict_reason: LiveAgent provides public REST APIs and a built-in MCP server, accessible via self-serve trial accounts and standard subscription plans.

evidence.snippet:
Your API key has to be set in header of your requests:
curl --location --request GET 'https://your.ladesk.com/api/v3/tickets' \

LiveAgent offers three subscription plans (Small at $15/agent, Medium at $29/agent, and Large at $49/agent), and API and integrations are included in each subscription without any additional costs. A 30-day free trial is available for all subscriptions.
LiveAgent exposes a built-in MCP server (Model Context Protocol) that lets you connect external AI tools — such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, claude.ai
